question: Which of the following festivals is associated with the state of Assam?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihu**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bihu** is a set of three important Assamese festivals celebrated in the state of Assam: Rongali or Bohag Bihu, Kongali or Kati Bihu, and Bhogali or Magh Bihu.
 
• These festivals mark the Assamese New Year and are considered very significant in Assamese culture.
 
• Bihu is celebrated with traditional dance, music, and feasting, and is a time for joy and community bonding.
 
• Rongali Bihu, celebrated in April, is the most popular and marks the beginning of the Assamese New Year.
 
• Kongali Bihu, observed in October, is more solemn and marks the time of growing crops.
 
• Bhogali Bihu, celebrated in January, is a harvest festival and marks the end of the harvesting season.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Onam** is a festival celebrated in Kerala.
 
• **Pongal** is a festival celebrated in Tamil Nadu.
 
• **Baisakhi** is a festival celebrated in Punjab.
